name: SSH 远程文件夹
description: 通过密码或本地密钥连接 SSH / SFTP，浏览远程目录并按需加载图像；TifMrcView Pro 还用它在服务器上处理数据
author: TifMrcView

en.name: SSH remote folders
en.description: Connect over SSH / SFTP with a password or a local key, browse remote folders and load images on demand; TifMrcView Pro also uses it to process data on the server

zh: 可选插件，软件默认不附带。需要时从插件市场安装，可随时停用或卸载。安装后顶部工具栏出现 SSH 按钮。
支持密码和本地私钥登录，通过 SSH / SFTP 浏览远程目录并按需缓存图像。TifMrcView Pro 的服务器处理也通过它连接。
en: Optional: not bundled with the app. Install it from the plugin market when you need it; it can be switched off or uninstalled at any time. Once installed, an SSH button appears in the toolbar.
Logs in with a password or a local private key, browses remote folders over SSH / SFTP and caches images on demand. TifMrcView Pro's server processing connects through it too.
